# ColdDirect

> Commercial refrigeration, catering cold-chain equipment and commercial air-conditioning repair services across London. Emergency and same-day options are subject to availability. Domestic household, gas cooking and laundry appliances are excluded unless a page explicitly states otherwise.

Business: ColdDirect
Address: 27 Felixstowe Road, Enfield, London N9 0DX
Telephone: 0203 952 4822 / 07983 759320
Email: info@colddirect.co.uk
Website: https://www.colddirect.co.uk/
Last reviewed: 2026-11-11

## Commercial fridge and freezer services
- [Commercial fridge repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/commercial-fridge-repair-london/): Urgent B2B cabinet, prep-counter and multideck breakdown recovery.
- [Fridge repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/fridge-repair-london/): Commercial qualification, data-plate identification and repair-versus-replace guidance.
- [Commercial freezer repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/commercial-freezer-repair-london/): Frozen-stock triage, HACCP readings and pull-down verification.
- [Freezer repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/freezer-repair-london/): Freezer categories, qualification and repair economics.

## Cold rooms and cellar cooling
- [Cold room repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/cold-room-repair-london/): Walk-in room, door, evaporator, controller and condensing-unit repairs.
- [Cellar cooler repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/cellar-cooler-repair-london/): Cooler-unit and refrigeration-circuit diagnosis for pubs and bars.
- [Cellar repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/cellar-repair-london/): Whole-cellar thermal, insulation, humidity and temperature-uniformity service.

## Catering, appliances and air conditioning
- [Catering repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/catering-repair-london/): Commercial catering refrigeration and kitchen cold-chain equipment; no gas cooking, dishwasher or CP42 work.
- [Commercial appliances repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/appliances-repair-london/): Master commercial cooling appliance router and equipment directory.
- [Air conditioning repair London](https://www.colddirect.co.uk/air-conditioning-repair-london/): Commercial split, cassette, ducted and VRV system repair services.
